one_line: AI safety tools, funding deals, product integrations, and new models dominate today's AI landscape.

themes.title: Tools to verify and align AI
themes.text: Anthropic released FlashProve, an open‑source prototype that generates cryptographic proofs that a language‑model reply came from a specific set of weights, running at about 110 tokens per second with proofs of ~19 MB. Researchers also introduced PEARL, a reinforcement‑learning method that suppresses misaligned behaviors in language models and remains effective after further fine‑tuning, demonstrated on Qwen3‑4B and GPT‑OSS‑20B.

stories.headline: Anthropic releases FlashProve to cryptographically verify AI model responses
New PEARL method durably suppresses misaligned behaviors in language models

themes.title: AI funding and acquisitions surge
themes.text: Meta Platforms is preparing a cross‑border investment‑grade bond sale that could raise at least $20 billion to fund AI and data‑center expansion. AI inference startup Fal raised $1.3 billion in a Series F round, valuing it at $16 billion after reporting $800 million in annualized revenue. Traversal secured $120 million in a Series B round, reaching a $1 billion valuation for its AI‑agent platform used in site reliability engineering. CrowdStrike announced agreements to acquire Fiddler AI for about $400 million and Dreadnode for about $95 million to extend its Falcon platform.

stories.headline: Meta targets at least $20 billion in cross‑border bond offering, debuting euro tranche
AI inference startup Fal valued at $16B after $1.3B funding round
Traversal raises $120 million at $1 billion valuation to expand AI‑driven site reliability engineering
CrowdStrike to acquire Fiddler AI for $400 million and Dreadnode for $95 million

themes.title: AI features in consumer and schools
themes.text: Apple announced that developers can integrate Siri AI into any iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS app via App Intents, starting with the iOS 27.3 beta. Google said K‑12 administrators can turn off Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and other AI features, but schools that block AI will also lose access to Google Search, which now always includes AI Mode and AI Overviews.

stories.headline: Apple opens Siri AI to all developers via App Intents in iOS 27.3 beta
Google lets schools disable Gemini but forces AI in Search

themes.title: New models and benchmark released
themes.text: The IndiaAI Mission unveiled three domestically developed foundation models—EKA‑1, Dhīr 2B, and Dhīr 5B—supporting multiple Indian languages and designed for on‑premise and offline use. Simon Willison demonstrated that the Qwen 3.8 27B model can read and reason about raw neural network weights on a laptop, reproducing results from a weight‑space programming paper. AllenAI released StateBench, a benchmark showing that current frontier transformer models struggle with long‑context state tracking compared to recurrent and hybrid models.

stories.headline: IndiaAI Mission unveils three indigenous AI foundation models
Simon Willison shows Qwen 3.8 27B can interpret raw model weights
StateBench benchmark reveals transformers struggle with long-context state tracking
